name: Protagonist
source:
The player-named protagonist, a submissive young man who easily bends to strong women's wills. Works as an administrator at HER Corporation, and is one of its few male employees.

[spoiler]His eventual fate depends on who he ends up with:
-If no one, he stays at his stepmom's place and serves her and her friends as their "sissy maid".
-If with Mari, he moves in with her and is made to dress like a baby girl and star in erotic videos.
-If with Shawna, he moves in to her mansion and is made to wear nothing but a tail butt plug, a dog ear headband and a collar, and to be her pet.
-If with Alexis, he is forced to cross-dress and be a stripper for her and her friends. Eventually they get married, with him as the wife and her as the husband; on the wedding night, he learns that the only sex that they will have will involve Alexis using a strap-on.[/spoiler]
